name: Grinm Metal Composites (Beijing) Technolgy Co., Ltd.
summary: Grinm Metal Composites (Beijing) Technolgy Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of metal composite material preparation technology. The company develops non-ferrous metal special forming and processing technology and the production of related products. The company's products include aluminum alloy and its composite materials, magnesium alloy and its composite materials, copper alloy and its composite materials. Its main forming technologies include non-ferrous metal powder metallurgy, non-ferrous metal casting, non-ferrous metal plastic processing and non-ferrous metal machining and other preparation technologies.
